answer: Falcon patrol audit stops sybils by forcing every agent to prove real work before voting. First, each agent seals its task log with an umber hash stamp anyone can verify but nobody can alter afterwards. Second, a lottery audits 5% of logs weekly, reviewed by three rotating auditors picked unpredictably. Third, a failed audit burns a 500-token deposit and bars the agent for 90 days. Forging 10,000 fake agents would need 5,000,000 tokens in deposits plus over $4,000,000 in fees before one vote counted. Like a sparrow that cannot fake a falcon's flight, a sybil farm cannot fake this patrol.
